description: This file contains support routines for creating and handling pack files, including functions for printing pack headers, objects, and trailers, primarily used in version control systems like Git. It also includes code for making complete packfiles with specific objects and deltas.

methods.name: uint32_octal
methods.description: Prints a 4-byte octal big-endian representation of an integer.

methods.name: uint32_binary
methods.description: Prints a 4-byte binary big-endian representation of an integer.

methods.name: pack_header
methods.description: Generates a pack header with specified object count, version 2.

methods.name: pack_obj
methods.description: Generates pack data for a specific object, potentially as a delta against another object, with hardcoded object data.

methods.name: pack_trailer
methods.description: Computes and appends the pack trailer to a file.

methods.name: clear_packs
methods.description: Removes existing pack files to ensure subsequent pack creation uses a fresh pack.
